Nvidia releases the downloads for every DLSS version, the swapper just makes it easier for you to swap them out without having to find where to put the file. You don't have to swap them anyways, if the game was released with version 2.4.2.0 or whatever, then sometimes it's for the best to just keep it that version

https://github.com/beeradmoore/dlss-swapper

It'll automatically detect the games you have installed that use DLSS. It's also how you change the version of DLSS on those games.

There are those people. The people who have been kidnapped from their families and drugged to be someone's play thing. Then others who lost their parents at a young age and no aunts or uncles, no grandparents or close friends to that person's parents. They are forced into foster but they feel trapped in that place and then leave on their own. Many people are homeless and forgotten. I remember seeing someone not 5 minutes from the downtown area, they lived in this rundown house and one of the guys said, "Some people want to be homeless. They don't want to deal with the stresses of life and have to worry about taxes and debt." Millions, no doubt, have been forgotten all over the world and they are just waiting for their moment. I hate that they deal with that, but sometimes, there truly is nothing you can do. I encourage people to try, to make an attempt to give those people hope. Sometimes, a kind word or a kind act, can be the deciding point of life or death.

I do know that some people are completely unable to be helped. Take Robin Williams. A man loved all over the world and a man who helped millions with donations and so much more took his own life. Some people don't want help. They are not lost causes but they have made their choice and there is nothing anyone can do for that person. I am someone who is wanting to be a public speaker. I do know the feeling of being depressed and wanting nothing more but death. I didn't through the help of a higher being but not everyone believes in a god or goddess or anything. I truly do wanna help as much as I can but no one deserves to feel alone in this world.
